objective: Break into Page 1 across Northern Michigan wine, hard cider, and craft spirits queries (Traverse City, Old Mission, Leelanau, Petoskey, Walloon Lake, Boyne, Harbor Springs, Charlevoix) by solving high-friction visitor logistics and winter/four-season planning in FIELD_GUIDE_V1.

dimensions.description: Immediate editorial answer and rights-verified Northern Michigan vineyard/harbor photography in static HTML above the fold; zero 100vh client-side bailout blockers before H1; SERP title <= 60 chars and meta description <= 158 chars.

Captures surging Q4/Q1 winter search intent: heated vineyard igloos and domes, on-site snowshoe-and-sip trail networks, apres-ski distillery handoffs near Boyne/Nub's Nob/Crystal/TC, and winter indoor/heated dog rules.

Unifies Wine (Old Mission/Leelanau cool-climate vinifera vs. Tip of the Mitt cold-hardy hybrids), Hard Cider (heritage orchard and urban taprooms), and Craft Spirits (bourbon/rye/vodka lounges open after 5 PM when vineyards close).

Distinguishes walk-in tasting rooms from reservation-required towers/igloos, group size caps (6-8), real lunch kitchens vs. snack crackers, single-peninsula/single-cluster driving math, rural rideshare scarcity, and clean HTML without double-escaped entities.

Co-located progressive CARTO/OSM Leaflet 1.9.4 map with grouped multi-stop markers (.wf-pin-multi), 4-axis interactive filters (Craft Category, Corridor, Winter/Trip Feature, Booking Rule), and 4-mode Tasting Day & Season Decoder.

Root-domain canonical on chrisizworski.com wired into /tools/, /michigan-destinations/ (replacing external traversecity.com leak), /michigan-winter-activities/, /michigan-winter-trails/, /frozen-michigan/, /petoskey-wine/, sitemap-winter.xml, and tool-network-registry.json.

hardStops: Any page ships a 100vh client-side loading box above the H1 on the root Field Guide.
Any photograph lacks explicit source/author/license attribution or misrepresents a venue.
Any Google Maps link routes to unverified turn-by-turn directions instead of view-only landmark coordinates.
Any Petoskey or TC page contains double-escaped HTML entities (&apos;) in visible copy.
Any Petoskey page defaults its static region recommender to Old Mission Peninsula instead of Petoskey.
Title exceeds 60 characters or meta description exceeds 158 characters.

corridors.name: Petoskey, Walloon Lake, Boyne, Harbor Springs & Charlevoix
